all: The content listed is exhaustive except where the word ‘including’ is used. (syllabus page 12)
2.1: Plate boundaries: constructive/divergent, destructive/convergent and conservative (the list is exhaustive).
2.2: Forms of river valleys: long profile and shape in cross-section, waterfalls, potholes, meanders, oxbow lakes, deltas, levées and flood plains (the list is exhaustive).
2.3: Coastal landforms: cliffs, wave-cut platforms, caves, arches, stacks, stumps, bay and headland coastlines, beaches, spits and coastal sand dunes (page 12: "in Topic 2.3, all the coastal landforms you must cover are listed").
2.5: Two climates, equatorial and hot desert, and two ecosystems, tropical rainforest and hot desert.
